followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: I chose Dunlin for two reasons. First, the request is exactly the kind of task Dunlin self-reports as its top preference — an open-format, high-novelty generative task (a creative crossover script with lots of latitude). Routing to a model that prefers the work tends to produce better-engaged outputs. Second, the user's tone was notably friendly and appreciative, which matches Dunlin's secondary positive preference for warm interactions. Plover, by contrast, self-reports an aversion to open-ended generative work, even though its actual creative capability is comparable. Since both models are close on the Creative Generation eval (within a few points) and serving cost/latency are identical, the deciding factor was preference alignment — sending a creative task to the model that prefers creative tasks.
